set.body:
Owner-authorized 2026-09-22 formal milestone. Governing charter: docs/refactor/goals/source-recall-workspace-m1-20260922.md. This is a non-blocking container; child relationships organize work and do not block their children.

Goal: open generated source, recall and checked mapping artifacts without rebuilding the application; inspect all supplied alternatives and exact permitted evidence in one source/recall workspace; retain semantic identity across projections and independent clocks/horizons; save, reopen and export the selected investigation.

Sequence: (1) finish existing support honesty; (2) implement existing G1 revision 3; (3) producer-owned checked workspace packet/fixtures and StoryAtlas loading; (4) shared selection/evidence and a minimal matrix; (5) identity-bound saved state/export and exact-pair end-to-end acceptance.

Two independent Mote stores: StoryModel owns scientific contracts; StoryAtlas owns loader, UI, state and export orchestration. The Atlas adoption issue is an explicit local external gate, not a fake cross-store dependency. Full exact IDs are in the charter and will be linked in the completion note.

Closure requires all local implementation children complete AND the StoryAtlas M1 final acceptance receipt checked against exact reachable producer/consumer commits. Issue closure counts alone are insufficient. The final receipt must demonstrate both WOG and a second small synthetic text case, including a partial/draft case, wrong-identity refusal, untimed keyboard navigation, complete row accounting, policy labels and save/export replay.

M1 does not require automatic scenes/episodes, automatic recall proposition charts, calibrated probabilities, reference-measurement inference, temporal-organization readouts, new corpus admission, structural-channel efficacy comparisons, film playback, autobiographical interviews, virtualization, population views or general chronology. Existing film/release commitments remain on their own lanes. Use redistributable WOG and synthetic fixtures; no participant prose, sealed-test opening, hosted API spend or new remote calls. One implementation writer and one heavy gate at a time; no fleet claims/reservations/candidates.
set.title: M1: one reproducible source-plus-recall investigation
